description: This Java class 'MerchantConfig' models configuration settings for a merchant, including display options and search configurations, and provides JSON serialization.

classes.name: MerchantConfig
classes.description: A Java class representing merchant configuration settings, including display options and search configurations, with JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the MerchantConfig object to a JSON string.

methods.name: setDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Sets whether to display the customer section.

methods.name: isDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Returns whether the customer section is set to be displayed.

methods.name: setDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Sets whether to display the 'Contact Us' section.

methods.name: isDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Returns whether the 'Contact Us' section is set to be displayed.

methods.name: setDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets whether to display the store address.

methods.name: isDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Returns whether the store address is set to be displayed.

methods.name: setUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Sets the default search configuration map.

methods.name: getUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Returns the default search configuration map.

methods.name: setDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Sets the default search configuration path map.

methods.name: getDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the default search configuration path map.

methods.name: setDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Sets whether to display 'Add to Cart' on featured items.

methods.name: isDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Returns whether 'Add to Cart' on featured items is enabled.
